title: Convert an existing npm repository to Megamono
description: Analyze and restructure an existing single-package or plain npm-workspace repository on a conversion branch.

appName.x-prompt: What should the existing application be called?

destination.description: Workspace-relative application destination; defaults to apps/<appName>.

interactive.description: Emit interactive-oriented plan guidance; mutation still requires explicit plan acceptance.

acceptPlan.description: Explicitly approve the rendered conversion plan for mutation.

resolutions.description: Explicit ownership for otherwise unclassified source-root entries.

report.description: Optional workspace-relative path for the Markdown analysis report.

scope.description: Nx scope tag and extracted-library import scope.

dryRun.description: Print the complete plan without changing the virtual tree.
